Wound / Skin Needs: No open wounds.
Oxygen / Respiratory Needs: Ventilator required continuously.
Dialysis Need: No dialysis.
Cognitive Status: Sedated intermittently, follows simple commands when awake.
Behavioral / Safety Concerns: No behaviors.
Infection / Isolation Status: No isolation required.
Advance Directive / Code Status: Full code.
Durable Medical Equipment Needs: Ventilator, suction, tube-feed pump.

PAYER / AUTH NOTE
Payer listed by sender: Medicare Part A
Authorization status reported: not_required
Authorization caveat: No payer caveat identified in this document.
